market_summary: Across the late New York session, metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD), major FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD), and BTCUSD are consolidating after extended downward runs, all trading below their respective session VWAPs, EMA50 baselines, and Value Area Lows on subdued sub-1.0 RVOL. Concurrently, US100 exhibits structural trend strength above VWAP and VAH but is in a corrective pullback following a clear rejection at Call Wall #1 (28431.43) under a Positive Dampening GEX regime. Without fresh yellow RVOL breakout confirmation and with prices range-bound near session extremes, all symbols warrant a strict HOLD.

signals.rationale: In the NEW_YORK_SESSION, price is trading below VAL (3893.78) and below POC (3978.13). CVD is BEARISH at -8.21 with a slope of -0.3, agreeing with the overarching downtrend but showing fading momentum. Price remains suppressed below both the falling VWAP (3934.19) and the EMA50 baseline (3915.82). Within the ATR envelope (3865.29 - 3906.41), candles are consolidating mid-to-lower channel beneath EMA20 (3885.85). Volume is low with RVOL at 0.757 and dark grey bars lacking yellow RVOL > 2.0 breakout interest. Price is chopping above Session Low (3852.35) and far below S/R resistance (3924.30), leaving no high-probability setup.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish, price well below downward-sloping VWAP

signals.rationale: During the NEW_YORK_SESSION, EURUSD trades below VAL (1.10719) and below POC (1.10942). CVD is NEUTRAL at -6,320 with a slope of -1991.77, diverging from previous aggressive selling. The pair remains firmly below declining VWAP (1.10790) and the EMA50 trendline (1.10763). Price is currently testing the lower ATR band (1.10494) within the 1.10494 to 1.10812 envelope. RVOL prints 0.662 with normal grey bars (18 bars since last yellow spike), indicating volume exhaustion rather than fresh breakdown momentum. With price testing Session Low (1.10457) and resistance overhead at S/R (1.10662), chasing stretched shorts into support without volume confirmation is low probability.

In the NEW_YORK_SESSION, GBPUSD is positioned below VAL (1.32510) and below POC (1.32731). CVD is BEARISH at -8,268 with a flattening slope of -95.53, aligning with the dominant decline. Price is trading below declining VWAP (1.32563) and EMA50 (1.32540). Candles are pinned near the lower ATR band (1.32238) within the ATR channel (1.32238 - 1.32603). RVOL is 0.926 with dark grey bars, indicating no yellow RVOL > 2.0 expansion volume to justify a breakdown continuation. Price sits just above Session Low (1.32210) and well below S/R resistance (1.32500), warranting a disciplined hold.

signals.rationale: During the NEW_YORK_SESSION, US100 trades above VAH (28231.55) and above POC (28122.95). CVD is NEUTRAL at +2.45 with a slope of +0.81. Price maintains structural strength above ascending VWAP (28174.64) and EMA50 (28224.70). In the ATR envelope (28097.03 - 28511.32), price is pulling back from the upper band toward EMA20 baseline (28304.18). RVOL is 0.804 (grey bars; Dukascopy index CFD tick volume rarely prints yellow RVOL > 2.0, but momentum is fading). Options GEX indicates a POSITIVE_DAMPENING regime above Gamma Flip (28299.41), favoring dealer mean-reversion. The signal candle rejected Call Wall #1 (28431.43) after wicking to 28473.75 below Session High (28550.97). Buying directly into Call Wall #1 is forbidden, while shorting against strong trend baselines and Put Wall #2 (28301.43) / Gamma Flip (28299.41) offers poor reward.
